findings.quote: If the state finds a household eligible, its full-month SNAP benefit is the maximum allotment minus 30% of SNAP net income, rounded up.

findings.field: SNAP Income Limits Are a Federal Reference
findings.quote: and most households must stay under both.
findings.defect: Income limits include equality; under incorrectly excludes the threshold.
findings.replacement: and most households must be at or below both limits.

findings.field: What are SNAP benefits income limits?
findings.quote: need gross monthly income under 130% of the poverty level and net income under 100%.
findings.defect: Income limits include equality; same defect in FAQ/derived schema.
findings.replacement: need gross monthly income at or below 130% of the poverty level and net income at or below 100%.

findings.field: SNAP Income Limits Are a Federal Reference

findings.field: SNAP Benefits for Older or Disabled Members

findings.defect: Same measured all-long-band run persists through the older-household rules.
